sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
1.
Heard Sri Diwakar Shukla, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.

2. By means of present writ petition, the petitioner is seeking direction to the respondent authorities to ensure fair, impartial and proper investigation of the Case Crime No.0029 of 2023 under Sections 498A, 307, 323, 354 IPC & 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Fatehpur.

3. Learned A.G.A. submits that the First Information Report has been lodged only in the month of December, 2023 and police authorities are under the obligation to do the investigation fairly and expeditiously and if the investigation has already not been completed, the same would be done at Smt Ishita Tiwari vs State Of Up And 7 Others on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86424373/
1

sentences.text:
. 
4. In the facts and circumstances of the case, the present petition is disposed of directing the police authorities to conclude the investigation of the said case fairly, impartially and expeditiously.
